articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Prudential Japan Sales Freeze Tests 2026 Earnings And Valuation Case. Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) has extended the suspension of new sales at its Japanese subsidiary by 180 days. The pause follows an ongoing investigation into misconduct in Japan. The company has warned that the suspension could have a material impact on operating income in 2026. For investors watching NYSE:PRU, Japan is an important market within Prudential Financial's broader life insurance and retirement services franchise.
